title: J Bravo Blames Tariffs for Inflation as Oil Hits $105
description:
Original video author: J Bravo. Independent recap and commentary; no endorsement implied. J Bravo blames tariffs for inflation in many everyday items, citing his reading of a New York Fed report. This recap covers his warnings about rising bond yields, oil he puts at $105 a barrel and storms threatening energy infrastructure. We distinguish his interpretation of Trump’s California remarks from established fact, then cover his AI terminology criticism, Bitcoin liquidation analysis and paid-course promotion. He also says he still prefers Trump over Harris.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.

#JBravo #JBravotariffsinflation #JBravoTrumpcommentary #tariffseverydayprices #NewYorkFedtariffsinflation
music_mood: light rhythmic instrumental groove, warm keys, crisp soft percussion, curious and approachable, steady moderate energy, no ominous tension, no sirens or trailer impacts
hook: J Bravo says tariffs drove inflation in many everyday items.
reporter_prompt: Five-second opening inside a US supermarket household-goods aisle, with American product packaging, shopping carts and everyday items clearly visible behind a middle-aged American male reporter wearing a blue polo. Warm practical lighting, relaxed eye contact, measured conversational delivery, no alarmed gestures. Horizontal composition. Add typography only in postproduction, never generate lettering in the footage. Throughout the edit use charcoal panels, orange emphasis, bold condensed white h
